d: Broken-hearted Brooke Yeardley makes her 30th birthday wish on the vision board she made as a teen. As her wishes start coming true, she finds out that life doesn't always follow a plan.
A mix-up over a purchase leaves amateur jeweler Melissa being enlisted by the CEO of the biggest jewelry company in Miami to help create a bridal line with the CEO's too-serious son, Jake.
When hard-working content creator Jenny goes on a retreat searching for a proper work/life balance, she ends up finding love as well.
A struggling baker returns to her hometown to try to get Christmas spirit back.
